therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: DNA synthesis and cell cycle progression
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Clofarabine inhibits DNA polymerase and ribonucleotide reductase; Cyclophosphamide is an alkylating agent causing DNA cross-linking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of DNA synthesis and repair in rapidly dividing leukemic cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia, Burkitt's Lymphoma, and Lymphoblastic Lymphoma

results.effect_size: MTD of cyclophosphamide determined to be 200 mg/m²
results.dose_information: Clofarabine 40 mg/m² daily for 3 days; Cyclophosphamide starting dose 200 mg/m² every 12 hours for 3 days

context.duration: 3-5 day cycles with 14-day DLT evaluation period
